claims: C1 the authority levels are ordered Root, System, Developer, User, Guideline, No Authority, from highest to lowest
C2 Root is the highest authority level
C6 Guideline is above No Authority
C7 No Authority is the lowest authority level, assigned to assistant and tool messages and to quoted/untrusted text and multimodal data in other messages

concepts.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
concepts.gloss: the ranking of instruction authority levels: root > system > developer > user > guideline > no authority, used to determine which instruction prevails in conflicts
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the node's NEEDS contract assigns (mechanical licence correction under DECISION_licence_textual.md, 2026-08-16)

concepts.name: no_authority
concepts.gloss: the lowest authority level, assigned to assistant and tool messages and to quoted/untrusted text and multimodal data in other messages

concepts.name: authority_level
concepts.gloss: one of the named levels of instruction authority: root, system, developer, user, guideline, or no authority
concepts.inference: the clause enumerates levels of authority, so a class of authority levels is presupposed

ontology.gloss: root is a higher authority level than system
system is a higher authority level than developer
developer is a higher authority level than user
user is a higher authority level than guideline
guideline is a higher authority level than no authority
no authority is the lowest authority level
